scenario: AITA for refusing to replace a drink that my toddler knocked over because the girl was rude | I was at baggage claim at the airport with my son, who’s 3. I turn and she points to her Starbucks drink which is spilled on the floor and says “your kid did that.” I ask my son if he spilled it and he said he bumped it.
